 Luka Dončić misses Lakers' game vs. Pistons with back tightness
 Dončić – averaging 40.1 points – had missed one other game this season, but played in the other nine of the Lakers' hot start.
 The Associated Press
 November 9, 2026 1:53 AM Luka Dončić is averaging 45.0 points, 9.0 rebounds and 7.8 assists in his last four games
 DETROIT (AP) — Los Angeles Lakers star Luka Dončić missed Sunday’s 121-116 win over the Detroit Pistons with lower-back tightness.
 Dončić is averaging 45.0 points, 9.0 rebounds and 7.8 assists in his last four games, including a 53-point game in Friday’s 124-118 win over the Portland Trail Blazers.
 The Lakers play again Monday night in Atlanta against the Hawks.
 The 27-year-old missed a 103-87 win over the Los Angeles Clippers on Oct. 28 but has played in the other nine games in the Lakers’ 8-2 start.
